description: Read the latest or a dated briefing for a niche: stories, reporting dates, source links, why each story matters, and new or continuing status. Use a slug from https://nicheangle.com/n or a custom niche's URL, such as founders or ai-leaders. Assistant access requires Pro. This reads an existing briefing without starting a scan. A quiet briefing has status=quiet; no_edition means no briefing is available; unknown_niche means the slug was not found.

date.description: Optional edition date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest edition.

name: niche_feed_read
title: Read a briefing
